title: Move a calculation to a worker

Explain the example for move a calculation to a worker

blocks.text: A web worker runs JavaScript in another thread. It can do a calculation without directly changing the page DOM.

Use these examples in a local page in a current browser. APIs involving files, storage, clipboard or location may need HTTPS, a user action or permission. They are shown as code because this site's sandbox limits those features.

blocks.title: Move a calculation to a worker

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `postMessage` sends data between the worker and page. Each side handles the message through its own listener.

blocks.text: With the two real files served locally, the main page logs 12 and then stops the worker.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Save the two sections as separate files. A worker cannot use document.querySelector to change the page.

blocks.text: Send 9 to the worker and predict its reply.
